_schema.purpose: Audit verdicts for atoms in docs/roadmap/atomic/dag.json. THIS is where a verdict is recorded — never by editing a generated <ID>.md, which the next generator run discards.
_schema.keys: one per atom id; keys beginning with _ are documentation and are ignored

verdict.confirmed: every done_when clause was checked against the code and holds
verdict.partial: some done_when clauses hold and others do not — say which in notes
verdict.contradicted: the status recorded in dag.json disagrees with the code
verdict.unverifiable: cannot be settled in this repo (needs hardware, a paid key, or an owner action)
verdict.unaudited: the default for an atom nobody has checked; normally absent rather than written

fields.evidence: list of concrete artifacts checked — paths, symbols, test names, measured counts
fields.ui_validated: what was DRIVEN in the running product through real user interaction, or absent if nothing was
fields.notes: the reasoning, especially any clause that did NOT hold
fields.follow_ups: list of PRs or issues opened as a result

_schema.rule: A verdict is a claim about evidence, not a vote. `confirmed` requires naming what was checked; an atom whose evidence is only a path that pre-existed the work is `partial` at best — see tools/audit_landed_atoms.py on why path-only evidence scores TRIVIAL.
